textNodes.text: This website is the portfolio of Mara Voss, an independent product designer and developer based in Berlin. I am responsible for the personal data collected through this site, and you can reach me at any time at the email address at the end of this page.
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif
"Mona Sans", sans-serif

textNodes.text: I only collect what I need to answer you and to keep the site running well.
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif
"Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: your name, email address, company, website, budget, timeline and your message. Only your name, email and message are required.
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif
"Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: if you write to me directly, I keep your address and our conversation.
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif
"Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: anonymous statistics about page views, referring sites, device type and country, collected by a privacy-friendly analytics tool that does not use cookies or follow you across other sites.
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif
"Mona Sans", sans-serif

textNodes.text: To reply to your enquiry and, if we decide to work together, to prepare a proposal and a contract.
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: To see which pages are useful, so I can improve the site.
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: To meet legal duties such as bookkeeping and tax records.
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: The legal bases are your consent, steps taken at your request before a contract, and my legitimate interest in running a secure and useful website.
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif
"Mona Sans", sans-serif

textNodes.text: This site only uses cookies that are strictly needed for it to work, for example to remember that you closed a notice. There are no advertising cookies and no third-party tracking pixels. If an embedded video or booking tool wants to set its own cookies, it will ask for your permission first.
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif
"Mona Sans", sans-serif

textNodes.text: I never sell your data or share it for marketing. A few trusted services process it on my behalf: the website host, the form and email provider and the analytics tool. Each one is bound by a data processing agreement and may only use your data to provide its service. When a provider is based outside the European Economic Area, the transfer is protected by standard contractual clauses.
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif
"Mona Sans", sans-serif

textNodes.text: Enquiries that do not become a project: deleted after 12 months.
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: Client correspondence and invoices: kept as long as the law requires, which in Germany can be up to 10 years.
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: Analytics: kept in aggregated form only, never linked to you.
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif
"Mona Sans", sans-serif

textNodes.text: You can ask me at any time to show you the personal data I hold about you, to correct it, to delete it, to restrict or object to how I use it, or to send you a copy in a portable format. Where I rely on your consent, you can withdraw it whenever you like. You also have the right to complain to your local data protection authority.
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif
"Mona Sans", sans-serif

textNodes.text: The site is served over HTTPS, my inbox and tools are protected with two-factor authentication, and I keep the data I hold to the minimum I need.
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif
"Mona Sans", sans-serif

textNodes.text: If I change how I handle your data, I will update this page and the date at the top. Important changes stay highlighted here for at least 30 days.
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif
"Chivo Mono", "Chivo Mono Placeholder", monospace

textNodes.text: Write to me and I’ll answer within a day, in plain words.
